# Use Ecwid with your AI.

Connect your account once and let the AI you already use work with it, without building another integration. Run your entire e-commerce catalog through your AI agent.

Included with plan

Ask AI about this Connector

Developed, maintained, and hosted by Vinkius.

MCP VERIFIED · PRODUCTION READY · VINKIUS GUARANTEED

Complete set · 10 capabilities

## The complete Ecwid capability set.

These are the exact actions your AI can choose when you ask it to work with Ecwid.

Capability set01 / 03

### 01-04

4 capabilities in this set.

Part of 10 available through Ecwid.

1. 01

#### Get app storage

This capability pulls specific values from your Ecwid application storage using a designated key.
2. 02

#### Get profile

Use this to retrieve your Ecwid store's configuration and profile settings.
3. 03

#### Search products

This capability searches your catalog and returns product IDs, names, prices, SKUs, and images.
4. 04

#### Search customers

This capability lets your agent find specific customer profiles within your Ecwid store.

Capability set02 / 03

### 05-07

3 capabilities in this set.

Part of 10 available through Ecwid.

1. 05

#### Get product

Get exhaustive details for a single product, including pricing, variations, and SEO info.
2. 06

#### List categories

This capability returns a list of all product categories in your store.
3. 07

#### List coupons

Use this to see the discount coupons currently active in your Ecwid account.

Capability set03 / 03

### 08-10

3 capabilities in this set.

Part of 10 available through Ecwid.

1. 08

#### Search orders

This capability finds orders and provides totals, fulfillment status, and buyer details.
2. 09

#### Update inventory

This capability changes the physical stock quantity for a specific product.
3. 10

#### Get order

Retrieve the full details of a specific order using its ID or order number.

Connect your client

## One URL. Every client.

Activate the Connector, copy your link, and paste it into the client you already use. 10 capabilities arrive ready to run.

Preview access · not provider authentication

The vk_preview_* token belongs to Vinkius preview infrastructure. It lets Claude discover and display the capabilities of Ecwid, so you can see the experience inside your AI.

It does not authenticate your account with Ecwid. Actions requiring credentials or live account data may not run until you activate the Connector and authorize the service.

![](https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=www.ecwid.com&sz=128)

### Ecwid Connector

You're all set. Choose your MCP client and follow the setup instructions.

Connector link`https://edge.vinkius.com/vk_preview_f2rUvFsEVzqcrb5YXmBZRd03rnfJlQFEaQfUp3mk/mcp`

![](/favicons/claude.png)

#### Claude Desktop

Follow the steps below to connect in seconds.

1. 1In Claude Desktop, open Settings → Connectors.
2. 2Click “Add custom connector” and paste the connector link above as the remote MCP server URL.
3. 3Click Add and start a new chat — Ecwid capabilities are ready to use.

```
    }
  }
}
```

Who it's for

## Built for the work Ecwid owners hand off.

This MCP is built for anyone running an Ecwid-powered business who wants to bypass the standard dashboard.

- 01

### Store Owners

Update inventory and monitor sales without logging into the Ecwid panel.
- 02

### Inventory Managers

Search for products and adjust stock levels using natural language.
- 03

### Customer Support

Quickly pull up order statuses and customer histories to answer questions.
- 04

### Developers

Verify product schemas and test API parameters via a chat interface.

FAQ

## Questions Ecwid owners ask.

- 01

### How do I connect my Ecwid store?

You need your Ecwid Store ID and a Secret Automation Token. You can find these in your Ecwid dashboard under Apps, then Develop Apps, then App Details.
- 02

### Which AI clients can I use with this MCP?

You can use any MCP-compatible client, including Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, and VS Code.
- 03

### Can I actually change my inventory through the AI?

Yes. The update_inventory capability allows you to change product stock levels directly through your agent.
- 04

### Does this work with my existing Ecwid products?

Yes. This MCP interacts with your live Ecwid catalog, allowing you to search, view, and modify your actual products and orders.
- 05

### Is my store data secure?

Vinkius hosts the MCP and manages your credentials securely, allowing your AI client to perform authorized actions on your behalf.
- 06

### Can my agent update product inventory in Ecwid?

Yes. Use the 'update_inventory' capability. Provide the product ID and the new quantity. The agent will command the Ecwid mutation endpoint to reset the physical stock level perfectly.
- 07

### How do I search for orders by a specific customer via chat?

First, use 'search_customers' to find the buyer details. Then, use 'search_orders' with appropriate filters. Your agent can retrieve the exact financial logs and fulfillment statuses for any order number.
- 08

### Can I see all active discount coupons through the agent?

Absolutely. Use the 'list_coupons' capability. Your agent will evaluate the distinct discounting rules in your account, allowing you to audit coupon boundaries and rules without manual dashboard checks.
